NONE: C1 moving forward to a later time or a more distant (= farther away) place

example: UK If you are continuing on an onward flight, your bags will be transferred automatically.
如果你要轉機繼續飛行，你的行李也會自動轉機。

NONE: C2 beginning at a particular time and continuing after it
從6時30分／3月份／19世紀70年代等起
C2 If you move onwards, you continue to go forwards.

example: I'm usually at home from five o'clock onwards.
我通常從五時起都在家。
We sailed onwards in a westerly direction.
Her publishing career started as an editorial assistant on a women's magazine and it was onwards and upwards from there.
她的出版事業從在一家女性雜誌做編輯助理起步，越做越成功。
